contract.goal: the six paged administrative listings over JPA rows filter with OData $filter only (explicit filter parameters removed), keep keyset paging, refuse $orderby/$top/$skip/$count, AND the filter under confinement, and audit paths/operators not values, as specified in the seven delta specs
contract.output: db-core AdminQueryFilter (+ OData-backed impl, unavailable fallback); AdminSurfaceGuard offset-option refusal; @Filterable allow-lists and $filter on audit, outbox, reconciliation runs, export runs, file-action submissions, PAT tokens with the explicit params removed; OpenAPI regenerated; revapi; READMEs EN+RU; admin guide; CHANGELOG at archive
constraints: no backward compatibility required (user, 2026-10-29): explicit filter params removed, signatures changed freely
keyset paging unchanged; no offset paging
a filter only narrows: ANDed under confinement, path scope, keyset
free text, secrets and PII never filterable
no admin entity published in OData metadata discovery
services without the OData starter still list (unfiltered); $filter then 400
done_when: mvn -pl :db-core,:security-spring-boot-starter,:audit-spring-boot-starter,:outbox-spring-boot-starter,:reconciliation-spring-boot-starter,:export-spring-boot-starter,:file-action-spring-boot-starter,:pat-spring-boot-starter + all in-repo dependents -am verify (one reactor install)

rollback_point: 061f467 (working tree carries the uncommitted earlier admin changes)
decisions: scope change before the first edit (user): no backward compatibility, and $filter replaces the explicit filter parameters on the six listings; proposal, design and the seven delta specs rewritten accordingly (audit 'via' requirement REMOVED, listing requirements MODIFIED, allow-lists ADDED); status filters now name stored fields and values. Removed parameters are ignored if sent (Spring ignores undeclared parameters).

1.1 (scope note: the proposal said odata-filter is unchanged): ODataQuery gains filterSummary() (FilterSummary of paths and operators, never values), set by ODataFilterService.parse from the summary it already built for its FilterAppliedEvent; constructor takes it as a fifth argument (the only construction site is the service; compatibility not required). db-core: AdminQueryFilter {ParsedFilter parse(Class<?> entity, String rawFilter)} with ParsedFilter(predicate, paths, operators) - where(), constrains(path), auditFacts() (filterPaths/filterOperators); ODataAdminQueryFilter (filterOnly through ODataFilterService) registered by AdminQueryFilterAutoConfiguration's nested @ConditionalOnClass(name)+@ConditionalOnBean config; UnavailableAdminQueryFilter fallback (blank = none, else AdminFilterUnavailableException, INVALID ludwig.admin.filter-unavailable, bundle EN+RU). db-core pom: optional odata-filter-spring-boot-starter. AdminQueryFilterTest 3/3 (delegation and summary without values; fallback; wiring with the service, without the bean, and with the class filtered out). db-core install 40 unit tests, 0 failures.

1.2: AdminSurfaceGuard refuses $orderby, $top, $skip and $count on any /admin/** handler with 400 ludwig.admin.query-option-unsupported (InvalidAdminRequestException.queryOption, bundle EN+RU), checked after authentication and before the handler's operation is resolved; $filter passes. AdminSurfaceMvcTest$PlatformChain 7/7 (+1). Module install 230 tests, 0 failures.

2.1: audit search takes $filter only: AuditTrailSearch.search(rawFilter, cursor, size) parses through AdminQueryFilter on AuditEventEntity; the 30-day default applies unless the filter names occurredAt; the search's audit event carries filterPaths/filterOperators (never values), from and returned. Filter record and the nine parameters removed from controller and service; AuditEventQueryRepository.findPage(Predicate filter, Instant from, confined, tenant, afterOccurredAt, afterId, limit). AuditTrailQuery (the programmatic find API, used by tests and user-settings) keeps its fields minus the orphaned via. @Filterable on 11 AuditEventEntity fields per the spec; audit pom gains optional odata-filter. AuditTrailSearchIntegrationTest 9/9 (rewritten to $filter, + filter cannot widen confinement, occurredAt lifts the window, reason refused, $skip refused, search audit has paths/operators and not the value). Module install 92 tests, 0 failures.

2.2: outbox messages listing takes $filter only (status/eventType/destination/createdBefore parameters removed); OutboxAdminService.messages(rawFilter, cursor, size) parses on OutboxMessage via AdminQueryFilter (new constructor parameter); OutboxAdminQueries.page(Predicate, ...). The bulk retry keeps its JSON body filter - it is an operation, not a listing. @Filterable on 12 OutboxMessage fields; optional odata-filter dependency. The listing has no read audit of its own, so no filter facts to record. OutboxAdminIntegrationTest 7/7 (+1: type-and-age filter, lastError/payload/idempotencyKey/lockedBy refused). Module install 133 tests, 0 failures.

2.3: run history takes $filter only (tier/status removed, and the envelope-to-outcome statusIs mapping with them); ReconciliationAdminService.runs(task, rawFilter, cursor, size) parses on SyncRun; the existing findPage(taskName, Predicate, ...) keeps the path's task underneath. The two constructors collapse into one (engine, enumerations, audit, objects, filters) - no compatibility required. @Filterable on 10 SyncRun fields; optional odata-filter dependency. ReconciliationRunHistoryIntegrationTest 9/9 (failed-scheduled listing rewritten to kind/outcome filter; + filter stays within the path's task, resultJson refused). Module install 320 tests, 0 failures.

2.4 (user decision, 2026-10-29): export's dialect rule is split - outside filter/config/entity nothing may reference the OData starter or Olingo (unchanged), and the entity package may reference only ru.ludwigandreas.odatafilter.annotation (new rule entitiesOnlyDeclareFilterableFields, with its reason). Export runs listing takes $filter only (requester/report/status removed); ExportAdminService(runs, subscriptions, lifecycle, basePath, filters, audit); ExportAdminQueries.runs(Predicate, afterCreatedAt, afterId). The subscriptions listing is not paged and keeps owner/report. @Filterable on 8 ExportReportRun fields (export already had the optional dependency). ExportAdminIntegrationTest 4/4 (+1: one requester's failed runs, filterExpression refused); ExportArchitectureTest 10/10. Module install 279 tests, 0 failures.

2.5: submissions listing takes $filter only (action/submitter/status removed, and the envelope-status-to-states mapping with them); FileActionAdminService(submissions, actions, filters, audit); FileActionAdminQueries.submissions(Predicate, afterSubmittedAt, afterId). @Filterable on 9 FileActionSubmissionEntity fields; optional odata-filter dependency. FileActionAdminIT 7/7 (rewritten: submittedBy, state in ('UPLOADED','VALIDATED'), state eq 'APPLIED'/'CANCELLED'; + declaredFilename refused). Module install 282 unit + 44 IT, 0 failures.

2.6: PAT listing takes $filter only (owner/status removed with the derived TokenStatus enum, now orphaned and deleted - 'active' is revokedAt eq null and expiry is a comparison on expiresAt); PatAdminService(tokens, queries, filters, audit, clock); PatQueryRepository.findForAdministration(Predicate, afterCreatedAt, afterId, limit), PatServiceTest's fake updated. @Filterable on 5 PatEntity fields; optional odata-filter dependency. PatAdminIT 5/5 (rewritten to ownerSubject/revokedAt filters; + secretDigest, keyId, lastUsedIp and name refused). Module install 124 unit + 63 IT, 0 failures.

4.1: two revapi entries - every changed/removed method of the six listings (controllers, services, repositories, auto-configuration bean methods), AuditTrailQuery::<init> and ODataQuery::<init>; and the removed PatAdminService.TokenStatus and AuditTrailSearch.Filter types. mvn -q validate rc=0; manifest rebuilt (db-core and five adopters gain the optional odata-filter edge), stale exits 0. api-docs check passes after refresh: notification-service and crud-service-example show $filter/cursor/size on the listings they run (audit, outbox; outbox, exports, fileactions) and the removed parameters gone.

4.2: a 'Filtering' paragraph before the grant block in all six adopters' READMEs (EN+RU): the shared rule, the filterable fields with stored values, indexed ones first where the migrations show an index (audit, outbox, reconciliation), what is not filterable, an example; audit's via sentence now points at actorVia. db-core README EN+RU documents AdminQueryFilter. Admin guide EN+RU: a 'Filtering administrative listings' paragraph, and the delegation paragraph's ?via= becomes $filter=actorVia. Follow-ups record added. Heading parity ok in all pairs; bundle parity ok (db-core, security); check_image_pins pass; openspec validate --strict valid. Left for archive: the Unreleased CHANGELOG entry of admin-delegation-claim still names ?via=.
